reviews.text: My company had me start using this app to scan paperwork and convert to PDF when I first started here. For that task it works “ok”. I got tired of the incessant ads and paid for premium ONLY to avoid the ads, not premium features. Original it was very simple to scan and save the PDF. With every update the unneeded and extensive menus require more and more. Clicks to save the file to my phone. You literally can’t even straight forward save a PDF anymore. I literally have to save a “long image” to be able to get to a menu to save a PDF. I won’t be surprised if they eventually add a “Platinum tier” at double the cost  that removes all the bloat so you can click 3 times and just save a PDF. It’s literally like Windows and iOS. Literally adding more and more features to complicate things unnecessarily.

reviews.title: STOP WITH THE SUBSCRIPTIONS
reviews.text:
Used for years to export pdfs of my handwritten homework to submit for my classes. You can imagine my disappointment when I go to export the pdf for my latest assignment, like I always have, and am prompted to pay for a subscription as it is now a subscription only feature. Are we joking? 

If any developers are interested in knowing how to keep people using your app, here’s a novelty idea that might shock you, keep the basic features free. Or at least keep the subscription price low enough to be insignificant. $10/ month just to export some freaking pdfs is WILD. Especially because there are hundreds of websites that do it for free (which I will be using over this garbage cash grab of an app).

reviews.title: I’ve reported this app billing tactics the FTC
reviews.text: Downloaded this app on October 19 2026. Signed up for a free trial and there was a tick box that said Mark here if you would like to be notified before your free trial end so you’re not billed. The app doesn’t send a push notification to your phone. It sends a quiet notification to the app messaging portal, which does not notify you that it was trying to get your attention. I brought this up to CamScanner and was redirected back to Apple to issue a refund. Apple denied the refund and when I brought that up to CamScanner, they said well that’s the final word and I said OK cool. Since then I have filed a fraud submission with the FTC against CamScanner because that is incredibly disingenuous of a service to blatantly say we’re gonna notify you so that you’re not billed and then they choose to do so in a way that is controlled to their environment only and if you’re not using the app, you’re not gonna be reminded because you’ll never see the notification. It is 2026. We are not playing with people’s money.

reviews.title: DO NOT USE
reviews.text: I used to use this app for YEARS to upload schoolwork and it worked amazingly and it was recommended by all my professors. Lately, there are an insane amount of ads. I don’t even mind ads as I completely understand but I will scan a page, AD, close the ad it pops up another AD. I click the X and it reopens the same AD. Cool now I have all my pages scanned. I click the pdf button and another 3 ADS. Cool now it’s in PDF and I need to send via email. Another few ADS. It’s absolutely RIDICULOUS. My absolute favorite ad they love to pop up is “your PDF is too old. Tap here to upgrade” WHAT DOES THAT EVEN MEAN????? I’d recommend finding another application as this app used to be great and now caused so much of a hassle to scan my pages. Even now, I will send the email and sometimes it does not even send the email to my inbox so if I’m tight on a deadline I’m kind of just out of luck unless it magically wants to work. I don’t want to hear from the developer saying “there is an X to close the ad just click it” or “make sure you have your inbox set up correctly” or some other nonsense that’s so obviously not the issue at hand. Make the app what it used to be again, and work on hiring a competent development team who actually understands what a user friendly experience looks and feels like. I urge everyone to NOT DOWNLOAD THIS APP UNDER ANY CIRCUMSTANCE AND FIND ANOTHER PDF SCANNER THAT CARES ABOUT USER EXPERIENCE AND NOT PURE AD REVENUE WITH NO APPLICATION USABILITY TO THE USER

reviews.title: I ’ve been a paying customer for about 15 years, but I’m now planning to leave
reviews.text:
I’ve been a paying customer for about 15 years, but I’m now planning to leave due to several serious issues I’ve experienced recently:
1. Scans became corrupted. Some older scans now have damaged/corrupted pages. Support advised me to re-scan them, but many are from around 10 years ago, and I no longer have the original documents. That is not a workable solution.
2. Unreliable Dropbox auto-upload. The Dropbox auto-upload feature syncs only some files, while others never upload. Support’s suggestion was to upload the missing files manually, which defeats the purpose of having an automatic backup.
3. Security concern: unauthenticated access via direct links. It appears that if someone obtains a direct URL, they can access the file list and file contents without authentication. Even if the links are hard to guess and you need developer tools to get them, a leaked link should not provide unrestricted access. Support did not address this issue at all.
Given the data integrity problems, unreliable syncing, and the lack of meaningful support, I’m moving my subscription to another scanning and backup service.
